figurative_meaning_en: Arrogance or pride stemming from wealth
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার টাকার গরমে সে সবাইকে উপেক্ষা করতে শুরু করেছে।
এই টাকার গরমে তার বন্ধুবান্ধব সবাই দূরে সরে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His heat of money has made him ignore everyone around him.
Due to the arrogance from his wealth, all his friends have distanced themselves.
note: This idiom reflects Bengali cultural emphasis on humility despite prosperity.
